name: Westfield Valley Fair
summary: Westfield Valley Fair is Silicon Valley's premier luxury shopping destination featuring an exceptional collection of high-end retailers including Bloomingdale's, Cartier, Christian Dior, and Patek Philippe. The upscale regional mall offers world-class dining with Din Tai Fung, Eataly, and Mastro's Steakhouse, along with modern amenities like EV charging stations.
demographics: Westfield Valley Fair attracts an affluent, tech-savvy demographic from the Silicon Valley area, with visitors typically ranging from middle-aged professionals to young families with high household incomes exceeding $150,000 annually. The trade area encompasses Santa Clara, San Jose, Cupertino, and surrounding communities known for their concentration of technology workers and executives who seek premium shopping experiences. Primary shoppers are fashion-conscious consumers with significant disposable income who value luxury brands, fine dining, and convenience, reflecting the center's positioning as the region's premier upscale retail destination. The visitor base includes both local residents making frequent visits for luxury purchases and out-of-area shoppers drawn by the unique concentration of high-end retailers unavailable elsewhere in Silicon Valley.
description: Westfield Valley Fair is a premier luxury shopping destination located in the heart of Silicon Valley at 2855 Stevens Creek Boulevard in Santa Clara, California. This upscale regional mall features an impressive collection of high-end retailers and designer boutiques, including luxury brands such as Bloomingdale's, Cartier, Christian Dior, Celine, Patek Philippe, Omega, Hublot, IWC Schaffhausen, and Jaeger-LeCoultre. The center offers a sophisticated dining experience with acclaimed restaurants including Din Tai Fung, Eataly, Mastro's Steakhouse, and Baekjeong Korean BBQ, complemented by entertainment options like Bowlero bowling. Beyond its exceptional retail and dining offerings, Westfield Valley Fair provides modern amenities including free Wi-Fi throughout the center, Electric Vehicle charging stations in the Monroe Parking Garage, and convenient package check lockers for shoppers. The mall serves as a lifestyle hub for the affluent Silicon Valley community, combining world-class shopping, fine dining, and entertainment all under one roof.
